company.shortDescription: Zogi Labs is a blockchain gaming and software development company that develops Web3 games, NFT-based gaming ecosystems.
company.description: Zogi Labs is a blockchain and game development company that develops blockchain-based gaming platforms, decentralized applications, NFT ecosystems, and play-to-earn multiplayer games. Its projects include Legends of Bezogia, an MMORPG game that integrates blockchain assets, NFTs, and token-based economies into gameplay systems. The company’s activities include blockchain development, decentralized application deployment, game studio operations, NFT integration, and Web3 gaming infrastructure.
